controls.assessment: Six existing credential roles only. Setup HSET is limited to 33 fixture hashes, SADD to four sets, ZADD to seven zsets and SET/DEL to the exact contract/probe key. BOOT durability is excluded from direct fixture state and setup writes. Ledger HSET has 17 exact data keys; PEXPIREAT has only the two reservation keys. No AUTH/legacy mutation selectors, wildcard keys, ACL administration, script loading or configuration mutation reach the ledger. Observer has no write/EVALSHA grants. Redis selectors remain command-and-key coupled, not a flattened union.

Both volumes must be empty non-symlink directories before chmod or writes. Config/ACL files use exclusive creation, 0600 and the fixed UID. Runtime loader selects exactly APPROVE_BOOT, TRY_CLAIM, START_REQUEST, FINISH_REQUEST, CANCEL_RESERVATION and MAINTAIN_RATE_SCOPES from pin-validated canonical source; it accepts no caller source. Its SCRIPT LOAD capability is not itself SHA-restricted by Redis ACL: closure is supplied by the trusted fixed program and early credential revocation. Setup/loader/boot are revoked before measurement; measurement receives only ledger/observer credentials.

controls.area: Probe, BOOT, setup and time binding
controls.assessment: Acknowledged probe binds fixture, plan, old Redis run and time; restart requires a distinct current run, exact persisted probe and no other keys. BOOT initial approval and identical replay are compared against the complete 12-field record. Verified probe time <= BOOT approval <= setup time, exact epoch, evidence digest and loss bound zero are enforced. Fresh 45-entry setup is read in full, including BOOT, before setup hashes/counters are retained. Measurement rechecks Redis run identity, full setup state, fixture summary and setup counters. Probe run-ID lexical validation is at the live producer and complete resume binding, not the inherited standalone probe receipt validator alone.

Only closed DB cardinalities 2/58/71/90 are admitted. DBSIZE and SCAN must agree with the expected full membership before value reads; unknown keys are not read for content. SCAN is bounded to 64 calls and 90 keys, keys/members to 256 bytes, hash fields to 64, field/string bytes to 2048, and collection members remain capped at 71. Exact TYPE, PEXPIRETIME, cardinality, fixed field/member lists and whole-state bytes are checked. Post-length-read oversized values and malformed scores are rejected. RESP still caps replies at 256 KiB, 512 items and nesting depth four. A 90-position inventory does not silently widen collection or byte limits.

controls.area: Fixed runtime trace and complete accounting
controls.assessment: Runtime calls wire_requests without a caller trace selector: only the 21-call finish trace is reachable. It contains six mutations, three group CAPACITY_BLOCKED replies with active_count=1/effective_concurrency=1/after_io=0, three errors, eight replays and one maintenance pass. Two runs/jobs/origins and one shared group use global2/group1/origin1 with zero intervals. Both actors and all four scopes are read together after each call and denial. Sixty unique counters count shared scopes once. Initial 60-second leases remain unrenewed and terminal reservation TTLs use exact one-day tombstones; replays must preserve them. No external request is issued.
controls.evidence: Source inspection, probes.json:reconstructed_receipt_baseline, measurement_end_30s_bound; canonical Go/Lua execution belongs to the coordinator's separate pending gate

controls.area: Authority negative coverage and peer semantics
controls.assessment: The inherited 46 negatives cover five mutating commands on all eight authority keys plus GET/HGET on three candidate/freeze keys. Each denial must be NOPERM and preserve full combined state. Static checks additionally reject candidate/freeze HMGET/HKEYS/HLEN/HSTRLEN/TTL/DUMP grants. These negatives test ledger authority, not real observer write denial. Both logical actors share one ledger credential with access to both actors' mutable job/run data: owner/token mismatch replies prove exact-wire semantic checks, not per-actor credential isolation. Authenticated peer reads are not a new permission grant.
controls.evidence: probes.json:exact_role_key_command_matrix_and_46_denials; no Redis ACL parser was run

controls.assessment: Plan and material are recomputed; unknown request fields, administrative profile overrides, extra role credentials and offline trace selectors reject. Public measurements omit credentials, owners, tokens, run/job IDs, reservation Q, transition IDs, URLs and origins; these appear only as fixed labels/counts or hashes. Controller guards both PASS and FAIL receipts against known private values. Raw Redis/transport/stderr text is not retained. Duplicate JSON fields and floats reject before dispatch.

controls.area: Serialized failure envelopes and ambiguous-call handling
controls.assessment: The actual worker serializer and actual Docker.stage receipt parser now both dispatch SharedFailure. Failure data can retain only the validated completed prefix with the next exact SGC label, STATE before rows, or ACL after all 21 rows. A malformed/tainted failure is rejected without serializing canary text; FAIL requires nonzero process exit. Each ledger operation is dispatched once; a lost reply stops measurement without retry or a success claim. Unobserved state after an ambiguous mutation is not asserted unchanged by the retained prefix.
controls.evidence: probes.json:actual_worker_*, actual_Docker_parser_*; existing test_shared_execution.py:171-240 inspected, not rerun as a duplicate suite

controls.area: Partial setup, stage budget, interrupt and revocation failure
controls.assessment: The inherited cleanup implementation is AST-identical to the retained foundation. Partial setup fails before measurement; no ambiguous setup/measure stage is retried. The 300-second case limit, <=30-second per-stage hard process alarm/transport-controller budget, and independent 60-second cleanup window are preserved. Worker kill/wait/PID-zero/removal precedes creation of a fresh revocation helper; revoker is deleted last. Held-session disconnect and fresh WRONGPASS with reachable Redis are required, not merely a failed ping. Interrupts enter cleanup, later cleanup signals cannot skip it, and failed revocation or removal prevents PASS. Cleanup only targets exact owned resources and refuses shared volumes.
